adapter.name: self-model

revision.note: no adapter for this system ships here; the run is not reproducible from this repository

adapter.caveat: Measures a consolidating design that does not ship an adapter here; the row is a data point, not something this repository can re-run.

accounting.description: counted at a local proxy, but this run predates the forwarded-call record, so the gap between forwarded and counted cannot be established from the artifact and the run is not treated as cost-comparable

provenance_note.why: These answers were produced against the corpus before publication, when a set of identifiers carried different names. The same substitution applied to the corpus at publication was applied to the answers, because an answer is derived from the corpus it read: a system reading the published corpus would have written the published name. Nothing else was changed.
provenance_note.verify: Applying substitutions.text then substitutions.question_ids to answers.as-answered.jsonl reproduces answers.jsonl exactly. One further substitution was applied at publication and is deliberately not listed: it replaced a registrable .com domain, and publishing its pre-image here would put that domain back into a public artifact. It is pre-applied in answers.as-answered.jsonl, so the map below still reproduces the rows.
provenance_note.not_a_rerun: This is not a run against the published corpus. The systems never saw it. Reproducing these numbers requires re-running the answer phase.

effect.note: The id map matters more than the text map: four question ids were renamed at publication, and without mapping them those four answers are reported as unanswered, which invalidates the run.

provenance_note.substitution_order: Text substitutions are applied in the listed order to the answer field; longer keys precede their prefixes. Question ids are replaced whole, never by substring.
provenance_note.run_id_note: run_id was renamed at publication for the same reason the corpus was de-identified. It names no answer row, so it is not part of the substitution map, which is only what reproduces answers.jsonl.

corpus_scope: A only. Corpus B was not run on this model; see results/README.md.

run_parameters.note: consolidating design; no round budget applies
